recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-42931 unless the publisher rendering regresses; any future regression should be fixed in the rendering/publisher path rather than by adding default multipleAnd/multipleOr values to core SearchParameter instances.
issue_request: FHIR-42931 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It reported that standard SearchParameter pages rendered omitted multipleAnd/multipleOr values as if repetition and comma-separated values were forbidden, and asked to confirm the intended missing-value semantics and how to handle standard R5/R6 search parameters. The final resolution was to render separate Multiple And and Multiple Or rows using the meaning-if-missing server-discretion text, while leaving values omitted by default unless a work group explicitly needs true or false.
initial_application: No commit in this FHIR source checkout directly mentions FHIR-42931. The underlying SearchParameter definitions had already been clarified by FHIR-40328 in commit 3625f3cd1975c798b2051bf5216f946563265678, adding meaningWhenMissing text for SearchParameter.multipleOr and SearchParameter.multipleAnd. The remaining FHIR-42931 application appears to have been a publisher/rendering change rather than a core source-data change; the current CI build now renders omitted values with server-discretion language.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2023-10-30 record the 9-0-0 vote and note that FHIR already defined the missing multipleAnd/multipleOr behavior. Zulip follow-up in November 2023 says the definition was correct, the rendering was oversimplified, and core parameters should generally remain missing unless a specific logical rule requires otherwise. Active fhir.ini entries include SearchParameter and Group, and representative Group search parameter source still omits multipleAnd/multipleOr as intended.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative SearchParameter structure definition already states the missing-value semantics, the standard Group search parameter source preserves unset defaults, and the current rendered Group search page no longer contains the misleading 'cannot repeat or have multiple values' wording. Populating multipleAnd/multipleOr across standard search parameters would change conformance semantics and contradict the Jira resolution.
